question: 충전 수준은 어떻게 확인하나요?
english_query: How do I check the charge level?

dense_candidates.title: Measuring the battery charge
dense_candidates.text:
Measuring the battery charge
Press and hold the [Talk] and [Volume (-)] buttons simultaneously. The status indicator flashes 4 times in different colors, according to the charge left in the battery.

First row (header unconfirmed): Column 1: Charge level | Column 2: Indicator color
Column 1: Charge level | Column 2: Indicator color
Column 1: More than 80% | Column 2: Blue
Column 1: 30-80% | Column 2: Purple
Column 1: Less than 30% | Column 2: Red
• The status indicator turns red while the device is being charged. The status indicator turns blue when charging is complete.

• Check the product box for the Level Box, charger (USB power adapter, USB cable), 3.5 mm audio cable, and user manual. The items supplied with the device and available accessories may vary by region.
• The status indicator is visible only when it is turned on.
Use only the battery charger supplied with the product. Using unapproved chargers may slow down the charging process or cause damage to the product.

dense_candidates.title: Charging the device
dense_candidates.text:
Charging the device
This device has a built-in battery. Charge the battery completely before using the device for the first time or after it has not been used for an extended period. Connect the charger to the Bluetooth speaker and plug the power cord into the power outlet.

Safety information
Do not touch the power cord with wet hands or disconnect the charger by pulling the cord
Use manufacturer-approved batteries, chargers, accessories, and supplies
• The battery charging time and run times may vary, depending on the usage environment.
